result.note: A brief item on a host-government action against an Indian firm abroad. It tests only which country issued the order.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, the President of which country ordered Tata Chemicals to halt its century-old soda ash operation there?
questions.explain: On 4 September 2026, Kenya's President ordered Tata Chemicals to halt its soda ash operation in the country. He cited compliance gaps and the operation's failure to produce benefits for locals.
questions.source: Kenya's President ordered Tata Chemicals to halt its century-old soda ash operation, citing compliance gaps and failure to produce benefits for locals.
